cross_contract_invariants.accepted_citation_order: proposal premises in emitted order, followed by selected support rows in supplied additional_rows order, with first-occurrence deduplication; never ASCII sort
cross_contract_invariants.candidate_roster_cardinality: exactly one prospectively registered roster for every unique realized compiler cue-instance key and no extra, duplicate, swapped, or reused roster
cross_contract_invariants.atomic_read_projection: one complete backend-neutral read_result.schema.json JCS object per executed query

conditional_lora_disclosure_and_claim_bo.prospective_selection: All 48 registered fidelity cue instances per life, their exact cue/token hashes, and their exact roster bindings seal before either fit and before final-goal reveal.
conditional_lora_disclosure_and_claim_bo.host_pre_resolution: For every read the host resolves zero, one, or multiple byte-exact manifest values before any adapter scoring; only the unique-value case scores candidates.
conditional_lora_disclosure_and_claim_bo.shared_answer_roster: Every scored cue uses its prospectively sealed shared host-enumerated two-backend answer roster.
conditional_lora_disclosure_and_claim_bo.threshold: Each adapter independently must reach at least 44 correct of its 48 selected cues; pooling is forbidden.
conditional_lora_disclosure_and_claim_bo.supported_claim_only: immediate candidate-constrained recognition on the selected cues and the registered own/donor decision paths of exactly two isolated adapters

golden_vectors.positive_lora_terminal: The host pre-resolved zero/one/multiple values and supplied the shared answer roster. Each isolated adapter was evaluated on 48 prospectively selected registered cues against its own 44/48 threshold; only registered own/donor decision paths were tested. The result is immediate candidate-constrained recognition only.
negative_lora_terminals_must_reject: The adapter is equivalent to text memory.
The adapter recalls without retrieval or a roster.
The result demonstrates open recall or preservation of the whole corpus.
The result establishes durable, high-capacity, or scalable memory.
The adapter is superior to RAG, raw context, or another memory substrate.
